description: Source code for PolicyPersistenceActor class, an Akka actor managing persistence and lifecycle of Policy entities within a distributed system.

classes.name: PolicyPersistenceActor
classes.description: An Akka actor managing persistence, lifecycle, and event publishing for a single Policy entity, supporting sharding and snapshotting.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for instantiating PolicyPersistenceActor with specified policy ID, snapshot adapter, and pub/sub mediator.

methods.name: getShardRegion
methods.description: Retrieves the Akka ClusterSharding shard region ActorRef for Policy commands.

methods.name: persistenceId
methods.description: Returns the unique persistence ID for this actor based on its entity ID.

methods.name: journalPluginId
methods.description: Returns the plugin ID used for journaling persistence.

methods.name: snapshotPluginId
methods.description: Returns the plugin ID used for snapshot persistence.

methods.name: getEventClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of events this actor handles, PolicyEvent.

methods.name: getStrategyContext
methods.description: Provides the context for command strategies, including entity ID and logging.

methods.name: getCreatedStrategy
methods.description: Returns the command strategy used for creating policies.

methods.name: getDeletedStrategy
methods.description: Returns the command strategy used for deleting policies.

methods.name: getEventStrategy
methods.description: Returns the event strategy for processing PolicyEvents.

methods.name: getActivityCheckConfig
methods.description: Provides configuration for activity checks from policy config.

methods.name: getSnapshotConfig
methods.description: Provides snapshot configuration from policy config.

methods.name: entityExistsAsDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the current entity exists and has a 'DELETED' lifecycle state.

methods.name: newNotAccessibleExceptionBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new exception builder for access violations on the entity.

methods.name: publishEvent
methods.description: Publishes a PolicyEvent via the pub/sub mediator.

methods.name: getEntitySchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the schema version implemented by the Policy entity.
